description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Vertiq designs and builds advanced propulsion systems for commercial and defense aerial vehicles. The Software Engineer - Manufacturing & Automation will develop and maintain Python, C++, web applications, automation, and internal tools that support manufacturing, testing, traceability, quality, and engineering operations while collaborating with hardware and operations teams.
Manufacturing automation software engineer building production, testing, traceability, and hardware integration tools

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain Python and C++ software and web apps used in production
• Build automation and internal tools that improve manufacturing, testing, traceability, quality, and engineering workflows
• Maintain and improve software used to configure, test, program, and diagnose Vertiq hardware
• Develop tools for collecting, processing, analyzing, and reporting production and test data
• Integrate software with hardware, test equipment, databases, and other internal systems
• Troubleshoot software and automation issues and work directly with technicians and engineers to resolve them
• Improve existing systems for reliability, usability, maintainability, and scalability
• Create scripts and tools to automate repetitive manual processes and reduce opportunities for human error
• Support deployment, documentation, version control, and ongoing maintenance of production software
• Work closely with mechanical, electrical, firmware, manufacturing, and quality teams to understand requirements and implement practical solutions
• Help establish and maintain good software engineering practices, including code reviews, testing, documentation, and configuration control
• Take ownership of small projects from requirements through implementation, deployment, and ongoing support

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field
• 1-3 years of software engineering experience, including relevant internships or substantial project experience
• Strong programming skills in Python, C++ and/or Web Development
• Experience with Git and standard software development practices
• Strong understanding of APIs and database design (SQL)
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, including well-documented code
• Comfortable working with hardware, manufacturing processes, and technical equipment
• Ability to troubleshoot problems systematically and work independently when needed
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
• Willingness to work hands-on in a production environment and learn new tools and technologies as needed
• Take complete ownership of any AI-assisted code, including test cases and documentation

Preferred:
• Experience with React, Flask/Django/FastAPI, Qt, or Linux is a plus
